items.exampleEn: My father looked at me angrily.
Luckily, the shop was still open.
Thank you for your frank answer.
It's annoying when people talk during a movie.
items.exampleZh: 看電影時有人講話很煩人。

items.exampleEn: My uncle has a playful smile.
Her new car filled him with envy.
items.exampleZh: 她的新車讓他羨慕不已。

items.exampleEn: The greedy king wanted more gold.
items.exampleZh: 那個貪心的國王想要更多金子。

items.sentenceEn: Luckily, I found my keys in my bag.
items.sentenceZh: 幸好我在包包裡找到了鑰匙。

items.audioEn: The noise from the building next door is really annoying.
items.audioZh: 隔壁大樓傳來的噪音真的很煩人。
items.questionZh: 什麼讓說話的人覺得很煩？

items.sentenceEn: My alarm clock makes an annoying sound.
Our cat is very playful in the morning.

items.stemZh: 「誰吃了我的蛋糕？」她生氣地大叫。

items.stemEn: My little brother is so ____. He wants all the snacks for himself.
items.stemZh: 我弟弟好貪吃，他想把零食全部留給自己。

items.passageEn: My little brother Tom is playful, but he can be annoying. Last week, my aunt gave us a box of snacks. Tom was greedy and took most of them. I looked at his snacks with envy, and I told him angrily, "That's not fair!" Mom was frank with him: "You need to share." Luckily, Tom said sorry and gave me half. After that, we played together happily.
items.passageZh: 我弟弟 Tom 很愛玩，但有時也很煩人。上週，阿姨送我們一盒零食。Tom 很貪心，拿走了大部分。我羨慕地看著他的零食，生氣地對他說：「這不公平！」媽媽坦白地跟他說：「你要跟別人分享。」幸好 Tom 道了歉，分了一半給我。之後我們就開開心心地一起玩。

questions.questionZh: 最後 Tom 做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 說實話，我覺得這個主意不太好。
referenceEn: To be frank, I don't think this idea is very good.
To be frank, I don't think this is a very good idea.
rubricZh: 用 to be frank 表示「說實話」，可放句首或句尾
「我覺得…不太好」可寫，例如 I don't think…is very good、I don't think it's a good idea 等

items.promptZh: 幸好我們在下雨前到家了。
referenceEn: We luckily got home before it rained.
Luckily, we got home before the rain started.
rubricZh: 用 luckily 表示「幸好」，可放句首或動詞前
過去的事用過去式（例如 got home）
「下雨前」可寫，例如 before it rained、before the rain started 等
